newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK VSZ EGM APPROVES SKK 3BLN, 3YR BOND.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK VSZ EGM APPROVES SKK 3BLN, 3YR BOND.

text.p: Shareholders of Slovak steel maker VSZ on Thursday approved a three billion crown, three year bond issue, the company said in a statement.
The statement gave no further details on the issue, but did say that former Transport Minister Alexander Rezes had been appointed as head of the firm's supervisory board.
Rezes tendered his resignation from the government at the beginning of March citing unspecified health reasons.
VSZ has said it expects to post an unconsolidated 1996 net profit of some 1.3 billion crowns, up about 100 million from the previous year.
It produced 3.4 million tonnes of sheet steel in 1996, and 3.07 million tonnes of rolled steel.
The firm exports some 70 percent of its production, mainly to European Union members and countries of central and eastern Europe.
